note: ANIM\CUTS.IMG is not in the published depot (noclip answers 404 under anim/) nor in the iOS bundle's repository. This copy is the PC install's, served out of a user-uploaded archive.org zip of unknown provenance (2024-03); its 444 entries are a .cut, .dat and .ifp for each of 148 cutscenes, every one of main.scm's 135 LOAD_CUTSCENE names among them. Only the cutscenes listed in `published` are packaged (tests/build-cutscenes.test.ts). The voices are the iOS bundle's CUTSCENE.osw, packaged by package-stream-tracks.mjs for the same list.
